# Game style

Gritty rural Japan horror, first person, overcast light.

```json style
{
  "intent": "Quiet rural-Japan horror; everything feels lived in, then left behind.",
  "camera": "first_person",
  "lighting": {"preset": "overcast_exterior"},
  "palette": {"shadow": "#1A1A1D"},
  "wear": {"edge": 0.5},
  "avoid": ["neon colors"]
}
```
